FN-IRDH6Z-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 491
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Government
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 05/22/2023
House Bill 491 introduced could increase the obligations of county boards of equalization by an
undetermined amount dependent on the cost to mail notices of the decision of the board to
taxpayers that have objected to the valuation of their assessed real property.
Further, the this bill would 1) provide that notice sent to a taxpayer regarding an increase in
assessed value of real property be sent no later than July 1, unless otherwise provided by the
Department of Revenue; and 2) allow a 30-day extension for a payment of ad valorem taxes
without penalty, under certain conditions regarding the appeal of the assessed value of the
property.
